snippet.description:
Samiksha Dwivedi believed 2024 would be her year, with the hope of securing a top 70 rank. But when things did not go as expected, disappointment turned into anger, defensiveness and self-doubt. She opens up about how these emotions affected her preparation and why the uncertainty of the UPSC process can be difficult to handle, even after reaching the interview stage.
